title: Senior Consultant - ReactJs, NodeJs, SQL, PLSQL
description:
About Ellucian:

Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI\-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best\-in\-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data\-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.
About the Opportunity:

 Ellucian is seeking an experienced **Senior** **Consultant** who will bring new and creative solutions to the evolution of our product while supporting our design principles: extensibility, configuration, usability, openness, and scalability. The individual will engage in the full development life cycle, from specification review to product adoption. The expectations for candidates to fill this role include significant experience in the areas below.

 **Where you will make an impact**

* Work with a team of developers and other peers to build API based integrations between the Banner/Colleague ERPs and third party products and test the processes according to the prepared specifications.
* Create and execute accurate unit test cases to ensure thorough integration testing of customization before delivery
* Leads and directs work of the functional/technical team on customer projects. Performs team lead functions for assigned project.
* Contributes to the definition of client engagement.
* Mentors and trains less experienced consultants and reviews their work.
* Supervises other consultants to develop organizational standards, effective practices and knowledgebase.
* Works with practice leadership to develop practice initiatives that promote growth and development within the practice.
* Interacts with the customer and other consultants to translate business requirements into functional specifications for conversions, reporting, interfaces and customizations.
* Monitors, tracks, and reports project risks, issues, milestones and work completed, as well as work that is underway. Provides leadership for the customer enabling them to stay on time and on task.
* Facilitates business process review and application prototyping sessions as well as providing
* Insight into best practice methodologies.
* Evaluates and modifies systems, where appropriate, relative to the customer business practices.
* Provides customer high\-quality business process, change management and other appropriate documentation.
* Provides direction in developing testing methodology and test scripts for use during upgrades, patch application and customizations.
* Works with the customer to test and confirm modifications and/or updates meet specifications.
* Implements modifications and/or updates.
* Provides guidance in the development of user\-training strategy, and when appropriate, delivers such training.
* Demonstrates strong problem\-solving skills and self\-starter attitude.
* Other duties as assigned.
* Strong communication and analytical skills with demonstrable presentation and professional communication skills (written and verbal).
* Demonstrated aptitude for logical application of problem\-solving techniques.
* Stay current with Ellucian applications
* Have an aptitude to learn new / related technologies quickly and apply them on the projects you work on.

**What you will bring**

* Bachelor in computer science degree or equivalent
* 7 – 12 years of programming experience in **JavaScript, React, Node JS**, Oracle SQL and Restful Web Services.
* Exhibits a strong sense of ownership for individual work assignments
* Experience working independently with little direction to achieve goals. Ability to work with a remote team leveraging available tools.
* Brings an established, effective method for tracking and completing tasks on time.
* Prefers a collaborative work environment over working solo, with a bias towards sharing credit for achievement over individual recognition.

**About the Company:**

  

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with revenues of more than $25 billion and approximately 1,30,000 employees globally. We help our customers accelerate life sciences research, solve complex analytical challenges, improve patient diagnostics, deliver medicines to market and increase laboratory productivity.


Through our world\-class brands – Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific and Unity Lab Services – we offer an unmatched combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and comprehensive services.

 **About Team:**

  

We are the Digital Foundation Platform team, the software centre of excellence (CoE) for Thermo Fisher Scientific. We develop and deliver foundational components, SaaS\-based applications, digital lab (Cloud\-based) tools, and foundational AI and agentic AI solutions to help scientists work more efficiently and precisely, enabling them to make our world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Our elite software products and solutions accelerate scientific discovery and lab productivity. These solutions

* Provide rich content, selection tools, teamwork tools, and scientific apps that allow our customers to focus on innovation and the complexities of their science.
* Build a connected world for our customers where discoveries happen in a thoughtful way — where every device/product is connected, self\-aware, and self\-healing—thereby enabling efficient workflows and collaborative science.
* Enable our customers to efficiently handle their labs by providing them with insight into workflow processes, asset uptime, and product availability.

  

We give them the flexibility to access what they need when they need it, allowing them to select and receive products and services across multiple channels. We apply industry\-standard methodologies to the design, development, and deployment of best\-in\-class software products built to demonstrate the power and scalability of the cloud.

 **Roles \& Responsibilities:**

 **Purpose:**  

  

The role is for a hands\-on Senior Engineer who could make a difference to the product in terms of the design and architecture, and actively contribute to the development of new features. This person will be a member of a cross\-functional team building a public cloud\-based SaaS delivery platform and associated application services.

 **Responsibilities:**

* Active contributions to identifying technical risks, alternative solutions to various problems, etc.
* Responsible for ownership of multiple significant software modules
* Responsible for leading the integrity of technical work on significant concurrent projects.
* Plans, participates, and performs the technical work of an assignment.
* Provides guidance regarding design activity to other programmers on technical aspects relating to the project.
* Leads the implementation, automated unit and integration testing, debugging, and integration of code of extreme complexity across multiple concurrent projects.
* Establishes and maintains thorough and accurate documentation of all work.
* Proactively looks for ways and patterns to continuously automate feature testing with measurable and tangible goals

 **Candidate Requirement:**

 **Education \& Experience levels:**

  

Bachelor's in Engineering/Computer Science or Master's degree or equivalent; proven experience of around 5\+ years

 **Skills, Knowledge and Experience:**

* Hands\-on experience designing web\-based applications in Java/Python technologies and UI technologies
* Hands\-on experience in Java application development frameworks and technologies: Java Spring and Hibernate, Python FastAPI or Flask
* Experience with databases, persistence frameworks, and SQL
* Solid design and programming experience and very strong in programming fields like object\-oriented principles, design patterns, data structures, and unit testing
* Significant experience using Agile Scrum development processes.
* Excellent analytical and technical skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work effectively with dispersed, remote, and global teams when needed.
* Having a wide range of experience and understanding of trends and technologies; uses technical knowledge to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways

**Mutuality:** You will design integration pathways that benefit both our internal business segments and our external partners. Whether integrating with a global retail customer or a third\-party logistics provider, you ensure interfaces are intuitive, standardized, and mutually productive.

**Efficiency:** You will champion SAP's "Clean Core" strategy, leveraging standard SAP pre\-packaged integration content and APIs to minimize custom modifications. By avoiding redundant designs and streamlining payload handling, you will maximize platform efficiency and lower operational costs.

**Freedom:** Guided by our long\-term generational perspective, you will have the autonomy to design innovative, future\-proof hybrid cloud architectures. You will possess the creative license to leverage modern event\-driven features to decouple legacy dependencies and optimize our core digital footprint.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1\. SAP BTP Integration Suite Technical Architecture \& Design**

* Serve as the lead hands\-on architect for SAP BTP Integration Suite (SAP BTP IS), defining design standards, governance, and reusable frameworks across the global enterprise.
* Design and implement complex end\-to\-end integration scenarios using Cloud Integration (CPI), SAP API Management, Open Connectors, and SAP Integration Advisor.
* Champion the "Clean Core" philosophy by utilizing standard SAP APIs (OData, SOAP) and extension methodologies to keep custom development external to the core S/4HANA or ECC systems.
* Lead the evaluation, technical design, and execution of legacy migration initiatives (such as migrating from SAP PI/PO to SAP BTP Integration Suite).
* Establish robust exception\-handling, centralized logging, and proactive monitoring policies for all SAP\-bound integration pipelines.

### **2\. Multi\-Platform Connectivity \& Adjacent Landscape Coexistence**

* Design and govern the connectivity boundaries where the SAP BTP tenant interfaces with our broader global middleware footprint.
* Collaborate with adjacent technology teams to ensure seamless data exchange between SAP BTP IS and other enterprise middleware systems, including Azure Integration Services (AIS), MuleSoft, and Solace PubSub\+.
* Ensure reliable SAP\-centric B2B/EDI transaction flows, integrating standard EDI messages from supply chain and retail partners through our external gateways (such as OpenText) into core SAP modules.

### **3\. Hands\-On Engineering \& DevOps Governance**

* Actively develop complex integration flows (iFlows), writing custom Groovy scripts, XSLT, or Java mappings where native adapters require customization.
* Define and govern CI/CD pipelines for SAP BTP IS deployments using modern DevOps tools (e.g., Git, Project Piper, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps) to automate testing and transport management.
* Perform runtime optimization, memory profiling, and database utilization tuning within the BTP environment to guarantee high performance under peak loads.
* Collaborate with security squads to configure robust authentication mechanisms, including OAuth 2\.0, SAML, principal propagation, and SSL certificate management.

### **4\. Segment Collaboration \& Knowledge Sharing**

* Partner closely with regional Business Relationship Managers, Segment Leaders, and Functional SAP squads (O2C, P2P, Supply Chain) to translate business requests into high\-fidelity technical specs.
* Act as an active technical mentor to junior integration developers and regional consultants, conducting peer code reviews and leading technical workshops.
* Maintain comprehensive, up\-to\-date architectural blueprints, interface catalogs, and setup documentation for all global SAP BTP configurations.

**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
-----------------------------------------

### **Industry \& Domain Expertise (Mandatory)**

* CPG/FMCG Sector Experience: Experience in working as an integration architect or technical lead within a global Consumer Packaged Goods, retail, or high\-volume manufacturing environment.
* Core SAP Functional Knowledge: Working familiarity with standard SAP functional modules and business cycles, including:

  

Order\-to\-Cash (O2C): Customer pricing, EDI orders, billing, and retail partner integrations.  

Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P): Supplier catalogs, automated purchasing, and material management.  

Supply Chain \& Logistics: Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), 3PL/4PL operations, inventory synchronization, and GS1 standard serialization.* Order\-to\-Cash (O2C): Customer pricing, EDI orders, billing, and retail partner integrations.
* Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P): Supplier catalogs, automated purchasing, and material management.
* Supply Chain \& Logistics: Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), 3PL/4PL operations, inventory synchronization, and GS1 standard serialization.

### **Technical Stack \& Platform Expertise**

* SAP BTP Integration Suite (Core Expert): Extensive hands\-on expertise with SAP Cloud Integration (CPI), SAP API Management, and SAP Event Mesh. Deep experience writing custom Groovy Scripts and processing standard IDocs, RFCs, and OData APIs.
* SAP Backend Ecosystem: Solid technical understanding of SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, and Cloud Line of Business applications (e.g., SAP Ariba, SuccessFactors, SAP IBP).

### **Soft Skills \& Leadership**

title: Software Engineering Manager — Funded Development
description:
### **Description**

  

We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The role sits at the intersection of engineering delivery and commercial commitment and is measured on how predictably the POD ships committed customer work on time, at the quality bar our clients expect, across multiple concurrent engagements.  

  

This is a working manager role: you are expected to stay close to the code — reviewing designs, code and stepping in on the hardest problems — while primarily driving delivery for the POD. The POD's core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Delivery \& stakeholder ownership** — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* **Hands\-on technical leadership \& design** — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* **Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence** — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* **AI\-assisted engineering** — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* **SE \+ SQE leadership** — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* **People management \& culture** — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

 **Essential Skills \& Experience*** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don't, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.

**Desirable Skills \& Experience*** Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.

  

### **Benefits**

  

***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India*** *We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* **Health \& Financial Security:**
	+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
* **Time Off \& Flexibility:**
	+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
	+ 21 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll over unused days.
	+ One dedicated day per year for volunteering.
	+ Two professional development days per year to allow uninterrupted professional development.
	+ An additional PTO day is added during milestone anniversary years.
	+ Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal.
	+ Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents).
* **Work\-Life Support \& Resources:**
	+ Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment.
	+ Milestone anniversary bonuses.
* **Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks:**
	+ Subsidy contributions toward gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives.
* **Our Culture:**
Forward\-thinking, culture\-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.  

	+

Trading Technologies (www.tradingtechnologies.com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market\-leading technology for the end\-to\-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) company delivers “multi\-X” solutions, with “X” representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. This multi\-X approach features trade execution services across futures and options, fixed income, foreign exchange (FX), and cryptocurrencies, augmented by solutions for data and analytics, including transaction cost analysis (TCA); quantitative trading; compliance and trade surveillance; clearing and post\-trade allocation; and infrastructure services. The award\-winning TT platform ecosystem also helps exchanges deliver innovative solutions to their market participants and technology companies to distribute their complementary offerings to Trading Technologies’ clients.  

Trading Technologies is backed by leading global investment firms Thoma Bravo, one of the world’s largest and most experienced software investors, and 7Ridge, a global growth equity firm focused on technology\-enabled businesses.
This investment supports Trading Technologies’ continued focus on product innovation, platform scalability, and long\-term growth for customers and partners worldwide.
  

*Trading Technologies (TT) is an equal\-opportunity employer. Equal employment has been, and continues to be, a required practice at the Company. Trading Technologies’ practice of equal employment opportunity is to recruit, hire, train, promote, and base all employment decisions on ability rather than race, color, religion, national origin, sex/gender orientation, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, parental status, veteran, or any other protected status. Additionally, TT participates in the E\-Verify Program for US offices.*  

  

### **About Trading Technologies**


Trading Technologies is a Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) technology platform provider to the global capital markets industry. The company’s award\-winning TT® platform connects to the world’s major international exchanges and liquidity venues in listed derivatives alongside a growing number of asset classes, including fixed income and cryptocurrencies. The TT platform delivers advanced tools for trade execution and order management, market data solutions, analytics, trade surveillance, risk management, and infrastructure services to the world’s leading sell\-side institutions, buy\-side firms, and exchanges. The company’s blue\-chip client base includes Tier 1 banks as well as brokers, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. These firms rely on the TT ecosystem to manage their end\-to\-end trading operations. In addition, exchanges utilize TT’s technology to deliver innovative solutions to their market participants. TT also strategically partners with technology companies to make their complementary offerings available to Trading Technologies’ global client base through the TT ecosystem.
